$doc: docs/DESIGN_Scenario_Regression.md §3 — airborne insertion: the stick of eight. Judge (1), (3), (4). One at a time = no man out before the man ahead + 0.5 s (behaviors lane: the drill orders at 0.8 x the interval, the exit read trails by the walk to the door; measured gaps 0.65-1.06). TRIAGE (CE-4042): runFor was 150 s, too short — all eight land at 106 s, a round canopy holds a man 40 s, then the walk to the rally; assembled by ~180 s, so runFor 220. 'Assembled' = a measured box (all eight within x 155-195, y 280-320 ≈ 20 m of the rally (175, 300), measured 165-185 x 290-310 at 200-220 s): the rally is the stick's middle landing point, deterministic here but not a constant a near cue could name. The squad's AssembleAfterDrop is a squad drill (not a mission task) so no task cue can see it (DESIGN §9, squad drill). The helicopter keeps its own 4 crew (9 aboard at the start), so 'empty' = Count 4; it flies on past x 450 at 38.75 s (its route returns to the start, not measured at the end), so that is a once, not an end state. NOT expressed: (2) 'within 150 m of his planned point' (Descent.Target is set at run time).
